about: Part 07 labelled set. Labels follow the definitions in build-plan/07-clickbait-check.md: cross = a specific clickbait or misleading pattern with enough evidence; tick = the headline states its main point and the article (when we have it) backs it up; neutral = not enough evidence, or no clear verdict (the default). A tick needs the article, so headline-only items are never labelled tick. Items with an article are scored as having full evidence, with the article as a short snippet. Written before the rules in src/core/clickbait, and not changed to suit them.

items.headline: Common painkiller cures blood cancer, study finds
items.label: cross

paragraphs: The drug killed cancer cells in mice, researchers reported. The team says the work is at an early stage and human trials have not started. Larger studies are needed before any treatment is tested.

items.headline: Coffee cures memory loss, says new study

paragraphs: The study followed 40 volunteers for six weeks. It found some improvement in word recall, but the sample was small. The authors said the results may need repeating in larger trials.
